pages.title: For every player
pages.text: /tv price: price of the item in hand. /tv reputation: your reputation and tier. /tv titles: your progress toward the specialization titles.

pages.title: Seasons (operator)
pages.text: /tv season info shows the season and day. /tv season set followed by spring, summer, autumn or winter, then an optional day, changes the season. Requires permission level 2.

pages.title: Showcase (operator)
pages.text: /tv showcase [position] builds a demonstration platform with one section per system, 20 blocks above you, and teleports you there. From the console, the position is required.
